# prose

[![CI](https://github.com/jdkato/prose/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/jdkato/prose/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Go Reference](https://pkg.go.dev/badge/github.com/jdkato/prose/v3.svg)](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/jdkato/prose/v3)
[![Coverage Status](https://coveralls.io/repos/github/jdkato/prose/badge.svg?branch=master)](https://coveralls.io/github/jdkato/prose?branch=master)
[![Go Report Card](https://goreportcard.com/badge/github.com/jdkato/prose)](https://goreportcard.com/report/github.com/jdkato/prose)

`prose` is a natural language processing library for Go — pure Go, no cgo, no
external services. English only.

- **Tokenization** — words and punctuation, with byte offsets
- **Segmentation** — sentences, via the Punkt algorithm
- **Tagging** — part of speech, using the Penn Treebank tag set
- **Entities** — people, places and organizations
- **Readability** — Flesch–Kincaid, Gunning fog, SMOG, Coleman–Liau and more
- **Case conversion** — title and sentence case, AP and Chicago styles

## Install

```console
go get github.com/jdkato/prose/v3
```

## Quick start

```go
package main

import (
    "fmt"
    "log"

    "github.com/jdkato/prose/v3"
)

func main() {
    doc, err := prose.NewDocument("Marie Curie studied in Paris. She won the Nobel Prize twice.")
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }

    for _, sent := range doc.Sentences() {
        fmt.Println(sent.Text)
    }

    for _, tok := range doc.Tokens() {
        fmt.Println(tok.Text, tok.Tag)
    }

    for _, ent := range doc.Entities() {
        fmt.Println(ent.Text, ent.Label)
        // Marie Curie PERSON
        // Paris GPE
    }
}
```

## Everything knows where it came from

Every token, sentence and entity carries a byte offset into the source, and the
text at that offset is exactly the text you were given:

```go
src[tok.Start:tok.End()] == tok.Text
```

That holds for multi-byte input, repeated words and irregular whitespace:

```go
src := "He said “hi there” to me."
doc, _ := prose.NewDocument(src)

for _, tok := range doc.Tokens() {
    fmt.Printf("%-8q [%d:%d] %q\n", tok.Text, tok.Start, tok.End(), tok.In(src))
}
```

It is also why `prose` never normalizes text before tokenizing. Replacing curly
quotes with straight ones, or `’` with `'`, changes byte lengths and
silently shifts every offset that follows. Normalization that would move bytes
is the caller's decision, made before `prose` sees the text.

# readable-by-ai

How much of your website can AI assistants actually read?

```
npx readable-by-ai https://example.com   # run without installing
npm i readable-by-ai                     # or add it to a project
```

AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini miss websites for two different reasons, and this tool tells them apart:

1. **They cannot get in.** `robots.txt` blocks their crawlers, or a firewall/CDN (often Cloudflare's bot protection) answers automated readers with a challenge page.
2. **They get in and find an empty page.** The site is built only with JavaScript (common with Lovable, Bolt, v0 and other single-page apps), and most AI crawlers do not run JavaScript.

It also checks what helps an assistant describe you correctly: title, description, language, canonical URL, headings, schema.org structured data (LocalBusiness and its subtypes, FAQPage), `llms.txt`, the sitemap, contact details written as text, and which platform the site is built with.

| Text with JavaScript (`--browser`) | Opens the page in a local headless Chrome and compares: "AI reads about X% of the text you see". |

# geo-audit

[![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.10%2B-blue)](https://www.python.org/)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](LICENSE)
[![Dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-none-lightgrey)](geo_audit.py)

A single-file, read-only script that checks whether AI search engines can crawl, read and cite your website.

## Why

More and more traffic starts in an AI answer instead of a list of links: ChatGPT search, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot and Google AI Overviews. These systems depend on things classic SEO tools rarely check together. Is `OAI-SearchBot` allowed in `robots.txt`? Does your WAF return 403 to `PerplexityBot`? Does your FAQPage markup match the text on the page? Is there a visible date, a source link, a number worth quoting?

`geo-audit` checks those in one run, prints a score out of 100 and lists the five fixes that matter most.

## Quick start

```sh
python geo_audit.py https://example.com
```

There is nothing to install. It runs on the Python 3.10+ standard library and finishes within about two minutes (10 s per request, 110 s total budget, at most 30 pages from your sitemap).

```
python geo_audit.py https://example.com --json          # machine-readable output
python geo_audit.py https://example.com --max 10        # audit fewer pages
python geo_audit.py https://example.com --banned b.txt  # fail pages containing listed phrases
python geo_audit.py https://example.com --lang tr       # Turkish output
```

## Example output

Real run against `https://example.com` (shortened):

```

· llms.txt: missing (optional; Google does not use it, citation effect unproven)
· Accept: text/markdown: returns HTML (optional: Cloudflare Markdown for Agents / .md copies)
✔ HTTP 200: 1/1 pages pass
✔ bot UA access: 1/1 pages return 200 to every bot UA
✘ JSON-LD: 0/1 pages pass  → add Organization+WebSite (home) and Article/FAQPage (content) JSON-LD; it must parse
✘ question-style subheadings: 0/1 pages pass  → turn real user questions into h2/h3 with a 1-2 sentence answer ...
✘ external sources: 0/1 pages pass  → li

# AEO Checker

Answer engine optimisation (AEO) is making a site easy for ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini and Google's AI Overviews to fetch, understand and cite. AEO Checker reads a site's code (HTML, JSX/TSX, Vue, Svelte, Astro, Markdown, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, llms.txt) or a live URL and reports what gets in the way, with a file, line and fix for each finding, so it can run on every commit and pull request.

```sh
npx github:pchewlo/aeo-check https://your-site.com
```

![aeo-check output for a single-page app: the home page scores 31/100 because main is empty without JavaScript, a noindex header and hash routing](docs/demo.svg)

You can also paste this repo's link into Claude Code, Codex or Cursor and ask it to check your site and fix what it finds.

## Install

Node 18 or later. No required dependencies; the Anthropic SDK is optional and only loaded by `--ai`, and Playwright is optional and only loaded by `--browser` (`npm install -D playwright && npx playwright install chromium`).

```sh
npx github:pchewlo/aeo-check            # run once, no install
npm install -D github:pchewlo/aeo-check  # then: npx aeo-check
```

## Usage

```sh
aeo-check                          # check the current repository
aeo-check ./site                   # check a sub-folder
aeo-check https://example.com      # fetch a live page as a crawler does (no JavaScript)
aeo-check https://example.com --max-pages 20
aeo-check https://example.com --browser   # also walk the main CTAs in headless Chromium
aeo-check --since origin/main      # report only files changed on this branch
aeo-check --format json            # also: sarif, github, markdown
aeo-check --list-rules
```

# SERP to Prompt Writer

A Windows desktop application that scrapes Google search results, performs multi-signal NLP analysis on top-ranking pages, and generates optimized AI writing prompts — all from a single keyword.

Built for internet marketers, SEO professionals, and content creators who need data-backed writing briefs instead of generic AI output.

![Search Tab](screenshots/01-search-tab.png)

---

## What It Does

1. **Searches Google** via the Serper API for your target keyword (paginated, up to 30 results)
2. **Scrapes top-ranking pages** — extracts full text, headings (H1-H6), outbound links, meta tags, and page structure
3. **Falls back to headless browser** (Chrome/Edge DevTools Protocol) for JavaScript-heavy pages
4. **Runs NLP analysis** on the scraped corpus:
   - TF-IDF keyword extraction with 3-signal rescoring (corpus frequency, BERT semantic similarity, TF-IDF)
   - Named Entity Recognition via ONNX Runtime (bert-base-NER)
   - Search intent classification (informational / commercial / transactional / navigational)
   - Content type detection via zero-shot NLI (distilbart-mnli)
   - Heading pattern analysis across competitors
   - Competitive benchmarks (word count, heading density, link density)
5. **Generates an optimized system prompt** you can paste directly into ChatGPT, Claude, or any AI writing tool

The result: a complete writing brief with target keywords, recommended outline, entity references, word count targets, and structural guidance — all derived from what Google is actually ranking right now.

---

### Batch Keyword Processing
Enter multiple keywords (one per line) and process them as a concurrent batch. URLs queue up for scraping while Serper API calls continue in parallel.

# Local Site Audit + Pitch

**Install free:** [Firefox Add-ons](https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/local-site-audit-pitch/) | [Microsoft Edge Add-ons](https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/hcdpnkilmailiiljmaeldcomceoibajh)

A browser extension for web designers, freelancers and small agencies who win
clients by showing them what is wrong with their current website.

Open a local business's site, click the icon, and in a few seconds you get:

- **Real defects, with evidence** - not a generic score.
- **Why each one costs the owner customers**, in words the owner understands.
- **A client report** to print, save as PDF or send, with your name and contact on it.
- **A pitch email written from the findings** - the top three issues, one fix given
  away free, and your price. Paste it into your mail app and attach the report.

![The audit popup](store/1-audit-popup.png)

## What it checks

Phone numbers visitors can't tap to call, pages that load without HTTPS, files
browsers block on a secure page, no mobile viewport, images with no alt text,
oversized images, an exposed WordPress version, a footer still showing an old
copyright year, broken links, a missing title or meta description.

Each issue in the popup links to a plain-English fix guide you can follow
yourself or forward to the site owner. The client report stays yours: it
carries no links of ours.

These are the faults found most often when scanning 43,000 US small-business
websites: 13,662 had images with no alt text, 7,646 showed a phone number
visitors could not tap, 4,338 still showed an old copyright year, and 2,202 did
not load at all.

![The client report](store/2-client-report.png)
![The pitch email](store/3-pitch-email.png)

## Private by design

The extension reads only the page you click it on, and only when you click.

remote code, no analytics. Your audits, your details and any license key stay in
your browser.

# AI Video Factory

**English** · [Türkçe](README-TR.md)

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/ersinkoc/AI-Video-Factory)](https://github.com/ersinkoc/AI-Video-Factory/releases)

An AI video factory that produces multilingual, animation-heavy YouTube videos from a single topic. Claude agents write the story and script, plan the shots, design the vector art and review their own output. Paid media APIs generate voice, images and video clips, and Remotion renders the final cut. A web Studio shows what is happening at every step and lets a human make the final call.

Architecture, provider choices and the roadmap are in [docs/PROJE_PLANI.md](docs/PROJE_PLANI.md) (Turkish). Release history: [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).

## Features

- **Topic to finished video.** The pipeline runs these stages: style → story → script → *approval* → cast → concept → *approval* → voice → shots → keyframes → clips → timeline → render → review. Every stage is idempotent and saves after each sub-step, so a failed run resumes where it stopped.
- **Four motion modes:**
  - `vector`: Claude-drawn SVG characters on a rig, animated in code. This is the cheapest mode.
  - `still`: images with Ken Burns motion.
  - `mixed`: some shots become AI video clips.
  - `animated`: every shot becomes an AI video clip.
- **Quality gate.** No SVG is used without a check:
  1. Before drawing, a planner agent studies reference images and turns the description into a concrete drawing plan.
  2. A blind reviewer says what the drawing shows without being told its name.
  3. A gate agent scores how recognisable it is and how faithful it is to the references.
  4. Drawings that fail are redrawn with the list of defects. If they still fail, they are not used.
- **Grounded in reality.** Real subjects are drawn from reference images found on Wikipedia and Wikimedia Commons. For objects, a ready-made public-domain/CC0 vector drawing from Commons is tried first; it is used only if it passes the same quality gate. Claude does not draw maps or flags: they are generated from real data (world-atlas, flag-icons).
- **The human has the final say.** In the Studio you can accept a drawing the gate rejected, or reject one it passed and add a note for the designer. You can also turn the reality check off for one episode.
- **24 ready-made style packs.** Examples include flat explainer, Ottoman miniature, film noir, blueprint, uki

Photoreal Blender scenes from a one-paragraph brief, built by AI agents.

6. cuts a behind-the-scenes video of how the scene was built.

No prop is modelled by hand. The two example scenes were each made in about a day of agent work, for about $150 of generation.

每个模板都是一个 `SKILL.md` 文件，不需要安装任何依赖，可以用在 Claude Code、WorkBuddy，也可以直接粘贴到 DeepSeek 等聊天工具。

## 怎么用

### DeepSeek 等聊天工具
1. 打开对应题材的 `SKILL.md`，复制全部内容。
2. 开一个新对话，粘贴发送。
3. 它回复"模板已就绪"后，发一句故事点子。

一部剧用一个对话，一个对话只用一个模板，否则容易串设定。

### Claude Code
把需要的题材文件夹复制到 `~/.claude/skills/`，然后直接发故事点子。

### WorkBuddy
如果你的版本支持导入 Skill，就导入对应文件夹；不支持就按聊天工具的方法整段粘贴。

## 常用指令

| 你说 | 它做 |
|---|---|
| 一句故事点子 | 输出立项卡和企划案 |
| 继续 | 写当前阶段的下一批，写完后进入下一阶段 |
| 第3集手册 | 写第3集的资产图和镜头 |
| 第3集发布包 | 写第3集的封面和文案 |
| 改：女主改成冷面师姐 | 只改相关部分，并检查前后是否矛盾 |

## 输出内容

1. **企划案**：故事、人物、世界体系、逐集剧情、伏笔、美术、声音、发布
2. **资产库**：人物、道具、场景、特效的出图提示词
3. **分集剧本**：分场与逐字对白
4. **分集导演手册**：本集资产图、分镜图提示词、分时段视频提示词
5. **发布包**：封面提示词、片尾与预告方案、发布文案

默认 30 集、每集约 4 分钟、9:16 竖屏，可以在点子里指定别的。镜头数和时长不固定：每个题材有自己的节奏，每集再按内容调整。

内容较长，所以分批输出，每批开头标明进度，回复"继续"写下一批。能直接写文件的工具可以连续写完，文件结构写在 `SKILL.md` 第一章。

## 使用前请注意

- **测试状态**：当前版本已在 WorkBuddy 实测通过；此前玄幻修仙版经过实际使用测试，宫斗、宅斗、年代文、系统无限流、总裁甜宠、重生复仇、职场商战做过安装校验或阶段1试跑；其余题材尚未逐一实测。
- **视频工具**：提示词里的 `{{Mixed N}}` 是参考图的引用写法，换工具时请改成对应写法。
- **上线合规**：发布前请按所在平台的规则确认内容，并标注 AI 生成内容。悬疑刑侦、民俗怪谈等题材平台要求较多，请先确认。
- **原创**：模板要求人物和设定全部原创。

# code-review-skill

English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

**Evidence-backed code review. Static-first, probe-driven, and gated.**

The skill source lives in [`skills/code-review/`](skills/code-review/), independently of any host's installation directory. The current version is a beta release; see [VERSION](VERSION).

[![Claude Code](https://img.shields.io/badge/Claude%20Code-skill-6B4FBB?style=flat-square)](https://claude.com/claude-code)
[![Agent Skills](https://img.shields.io/badge/Agent%20Skills-standard-1f6feb?style=flat-square)](https://agentskills.io)
[![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3.9%2B-3776AB?style=flat-square&logo=python&logoColor=white)](https://www.python.org/)
[![Static-first](https://img.shields.io/badge/review-static--first-2ea44f?style=flat-square)](#what-this-is-not)
[![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/kyy-logs/code-review-skill?style=flat-square&logo=github)](https://github.com/kyy-logs/code-review-skill/stargazers)

Most AI reviews stop at “this looks risky.” This skill produces a review you can audit: every finding points to a location, a contract or code path, and a severity; every gate decision is rendered from machine-readable JSON. It reads the diff, surrounding source, tests, and project rules — no build, test run, or coverage report required.

It never modifies the code under review.

## Latest news

  `review-mode`, and reviewer-adapter installation are no longer used.

#### Changed

- The installer now installs only the host skill layout. `--agent` selects the
  Claude Code or Codex skill directory, not a reviewer adapter.

[Full update history](NEWS.md)

gate behavior may change before 1.0.

  records before using them with this release.
- **Scope:** static-first review with four probes and JSON-derived report/gate
  output. It does not replace tests, CI, or human review.
